description: This file implements webhook handling for LINE messaging platform, including middleware creation, request parsing, signature validation, and webhook startup configuration.

methods.name: readRawBody
methods.description: Reads the raw request body from an Express request object, handling Buffer and string types.

methods.name: parseWebhookBody
methods.description: Parses the raw request body into a WebhookRequestBody object using an external parser.

methods.name: createLineWebhookMiddleware
methods.description: Creates Express middleware to handle LINE webhook requests, including signature validation and event processing.

methods.name: startLineWebhook
methods.description: Initializes and returns the webhook endpoint path and handler, validating the channel secret.
